profile.headline: Advanced Software Engineer at Honeywell
profile.summary:
Broad experience in design, development, Testing and implementation of variety of software applications that includes web based, stand alone applications and object oriented paradigm.

Always interested in web development, project management, requirements gathering, analysing, planning, documenting, Impact analysis and monitoring progress of projects.

Specialties: .NET, ASP.NET, MVC.NET, WebAPI, WCF, Web Services, Fluent NHibernate, C#, JavaScript, JQuery, VSTS, C#,  OOP, MSSQL 2000/2005/2008, MySQL 5.0, Responsive web designs

Industries: Supply Chain Management, Warehouse mgt, ERP Solutions, eCommerce Applications, Community Portals, Financial Advisory systems, Oil & Gas , HealthCare
